This patch replaces the large Android debug APKs with optimized release builds.

| Android APK | v0.1.0 debug | v0.1.1 optimized | Reduction |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| ARM64 | 178.50 MB | 9.18 MB | 94.9% |
| x64 | 179.40 MB | 9.84 MB | 94.5% |

Sizes are the actual APK download sizes in decimal MB.

- Rust release compilation with size optimization, Thin LTO, one codegen unit,
  and stripped native symbols.
- R8 code and resource optimization from the pinned Tauri Android template.
- Separate ARM64 and x64 APKs, with verified signatures.
- CI rejects APKs over 25 MiB, unexpected ABIs, and native debug symbols.

### Downloads

For most Android phones, choose `d110-studio_0.1.1_android-arm64.apk`.
The x64 APK is intended for emulators. Android 8.0 or later is required.
Linux, Windows, and macOS installers are also included, together with
`SHA256SUMS.txt` for all 12 installers.

### Build and device testing

All installers come from [successful CI run 38910379583](https://github.com/Rhonstin/niimbot-d110/actions/runs/38910379583), commit `4c3cb8c360db4876e38539c077347fa419575c57`.

Android release code is signed with the CI runner's development certificate.
It is suitable for testing, without Play Store production signing. Each CI run
uses a new development certificate, so installing over an earlier development
APK may require uninstalling that version first; uninstalling clears saved labels.
Desktop installers remain unsigned, and macOS builds are not notarized.
Physical Bluetooth printing on Windows, macOS, and Android still needs device testing.
